statusCorrection.reason: The full source is a single Midwestern U.S. academy cohort (regional developmental academy transitioning to one MLS Next academy), not NCAA, High School RIO, NATION/Datalys, national U.S. surveillance, or an overlapping companion study. It is therefore eligible for manual extraction and remains awaiting human review.

sourceCoverage: Primary PDF pp. 1-7 visually and textually inspected: abstract, introduction, methods, Table 1, Table 2, Figure 1, Table 3, Table 4, Table 5, results, discussion, limitations, acknowledgments, and references. Figure 1 was readable and checked but only restates Table 2 season/team exposure and incidence values.

populationLayout.rationale: This is the strongest direct source axis. U16 and U18 are not reported by the source and were not invented.

directValueCaveats: Table 2 player counts are source-reported starting-roster estimates and may count athletes across seasons; they are not inferred unique-player totals.
Table 3 is scoped to 331 injury events; Table 4 is scoped to 338 diagnoses/type events because seven events had more than one type. Values are retained in their respective scopes.
Broad tissue parent rows use only transparent sums of compatible Table 4 subrows. No rate-to-count, count-to-exposure, burden, recurrence, or match/training-exposure calculation was made.
Combined source locations/types without a clean schema target (including hip/groin and mixed multi-location rows) were not forced into narrower fields.
